description_en: Queries the details of a specified OTA update batch
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定升级批次的详情
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-ota-job --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --job-id wahVIzGkCMuAUE2gDERM020000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryOTAJob

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the update batch.

This is the **JobId** returned after you call [CreateOTAVerifyJob](~~147480~~), [CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob](~~147496~~), or [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob](~~147887~~) to create an update batch. You can also view the ID on the **Update Package Details** page in the IoT Platform console.
parameters.description_zh:
升级批次ID。

您调用[CreateOTAVerifyJob](~~147480~~)、[CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob](~~147496~~)或[CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob](~~147887~~)创建升级任务批次后，返回的**JobId**。您也可以在物联网平台控制台的**升级包详情**页面查看。
